listingDraft.shortDescriptionEs: Encuentra alojamientos para tu próxima escapada.
listingDraft.shortDescriptionEn: Find places to stay for your next getaway.
listingDraft.fullDescriptionEs: Descubre alojamientos y planifica tus escapadas con AkiDuermo. Explora propiedades y zonas de España, consulta detalles y disponibilidad publicada y envía solicitudes de reserva cuando el alojamiento lo permita. La reserva no queda confirmada hasta que el establecimiento la acepte.
listingDraft.fullDescriptionEn: Discover places to stay and plan trips with AkiDuermo. Explore accommodation across Spain, review property details and published availability, and send booking requests where supported. A request is not a confirmed reservation until the property accepts it.

sourceObservation: Cloudflare confirms production akiduermo.com is served by Worker akiduermo. This repo's default main README is historical extraction groundwork; active extraction and account dashboard are in PRs #1, #2, and #6. Confirm exact production source commit and reconcile independent app before mobile build.

notes: Do not insert app signing keys, provisioning profiles, personal details, reviewer passwords or store API keys in Git.
Do not publish android/.well-known/assetlinks.json or apple-app-site-association with guessed fingerprints/team IDs.
Respect AkiSuite cross-domain OAuth callback and application deep linking; each product must survive login, logout and password recovery.
No automatic purchase-flow enabling: review mobile digital subscription rules and local availability before release.
